title.official: Service of originating application and evidence

operative_text.controlling:
3.9   Except as otherwise provided in rule 3.15(5), an originating
application and any affidavit and other evidence filed with the
originating application must be served on each of the other parties
10 days or more before the date scheduled for hearing the
application.

expressly bar extending the limitation period. If the last day falls on a weekend, service on the next business day suffices.
